stage0020_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Listen, $$シンジ$$?
　With the Crusher Team gone,
　you're the only one who can fight.」

stage0020_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$シンジ$$
「You don't have to yell, I can hear you.」

stage0020_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Then answer me.
　You move under my command.」

stage0020_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$リツコ$$
（Looks like he's in the worst state of mind.）

stage0020_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Attack target, $$第５の使徒$$...!
　$$エヴァンゲリオン初号機$$, commence attack!」

stage0020_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$シンジ$$
（I fought before, thinking I could do something...
　but even fighting, some people I can't protect...）

stage0020_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$シンジ$$
（Those people surely won't forgive me...
　Then what am I even fighting for...
　if it means being hated...）

stage0020_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「Amazing!
　Sneaking out of the shelter to watch was
　so worth it!」

stage0020_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$トウジ$$
「But you're a weirdo too.
　Wanting to see the fight live and all.」

stage0020_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「If I miss this chance,
　I might never get another.」

stage0020_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$トウジ$$
「Guess it can't be helped...
　You're really honest about what you want, huh.」

stage0020_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$赤木$$
「Hey, you two!
　What are you doing in a place like this!?」

stage0020_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「W-well, what do you mean...」

stage0020_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$赤木$$
「This place is dangerous!
　Evacuate, now!」

stage0020_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$赤木$$
「$$シンジ$$!
　Are you all right, $$シンジ$$!」

stage0020_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$赤木$$
「Can you hear me, $$シンジ$$!
　Protect these two!」

stage0020_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$赤木$$
「You have the power to do it!
　Just try!」

stage0020_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$ミサト$$
「$$シンジ$$, get those two into the cockpit!」

stage0020_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$ミサト$$
「That's the only way right now!」

stage0020_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$赤木$$
「Come on, you two!
　Get in the EVA!」

stage0020_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$赤木$$
「I've survived plenty of tight spots before!
　I'll make it out alive, guaranteed!」

stage0020_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$ミサト$$
「You two, hurry up!
　The Angel's coming!」

stage0020_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I have... no choice but to do it!」

stage0020_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$マコト$$
「Confirmed approach of an unidentified unit!」

stage0020_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$マヤ$$
「Target identified!
　This... is the unit that appeared before!」

stage0020_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$ミサト$$
「A Mechanical Beast Army!
　At a time like this...!」

stage0020_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「$$兜甲児$$ hasn't arrived yet.
　Then let's sit back here and enjoy watching
　the world meet its end.」

stage0020_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$ミサト$$
「The Crusher Team came to help!」

stage0020_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$マコト$$
「Querying the Earth Federation Forces database!
　It's an Unknown, likely thrown here by a
　dimensional tremor, with only one sighting so far!」

stage0020_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Nnngh!
　Why are you attacking us!」

stage0020_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Blast it, retreat!
　We can't fight without our pawns!」

stage0020_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$シゲル$$
「The unknown appears to be attacking the Angel.」

stage0020_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Launch Unit-00.
　We will annihilate the Angel and the Unknown.」

stage0020_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「What's going on, transfer student!
　Is that bat thing an enemy too!?」

stage0020_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$トウジ$$
「Idiot!
　Not knowing won't cut it!」

stage0020_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$シンジ$$
「If I don't know, I don't know!」

stage0020_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$ミサト$$
「$$シンジ$$, change of plan.
　Team up with $$レイ#333$$ against the Angel and the Unknown.」

stage0020_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$シンジ$$
「No way...!
　We're outnumbered by too much!」

stage0020_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$マコト$$
「EVA has switched to internal power!」

stage0020_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$ミサト$$
「You heard that, $$シンジ$$!
　With only six minutes left, prioritize the Angel!」

stage0020_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$ミサト$$
「$$レイ#333$$!
　Your Unit-00 has a repair unit installed!
　Back up $$シンジ$$!」

stage0020_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$ミサト$$
「The priority target's still the Angel,
　but watch out for the Unknown too!」

stage0020_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I have to... I have no choice...
　If I don't, these two here too...」

stage0020_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$赤木$$
「Of course!
　If the hero of justice goes and dies,
　he can't protect everyone, right!」

stage0020_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$n
「That's a bat that showed up with the $$ジェニオン$$!」

stage0020_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$スズネ$$
「But wasn't it just an accident that brought
　that thing here in a dimensional tremor...!」

stage0020_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$葵$$
「That Unknown,
　looks like it means to hit both us and the Angel.」

stage0020_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Then we'll just crush them both!」

stage0020_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$佐伯$$
「Lt. Col. Katsuragi,
　will that be all right?」

stage0020_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$ミサト$$
「The Unknown appears to be unmanned.
　We have no choice but to fight back.」

stage0020_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$ミサト$$
「The EVA's time limit is approaching.
　Please help us clear the obstacle quickly.」

stage0020_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Just as you heard.
　Our targets are the Angel and the Unknown...
　We will annihilate them both.」

stage0020_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$ミサト$$
「$$レイ#333$$, back up $$シンジ$$!」

stage0020_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$シンジ$$
（Duty... the role I'm meant to play...
　I...）

stage0020_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$シゲル$$
「The target has completely lost its form.」

stage0020_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$ミサト$$
「$$シンジ$$!
　Force open the Angel's A.T. Field in close combat,
　and destroy its core!」

stage0020_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$赤木$$
「You too bear everyone's lives on your back!」

stage0020_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$シゲル$$
「The target has completely lost its form.」

stage0020_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$ブロッケン$$, who got to $$第３新東京市$$ before us,
　apparently got driven off by those guys...」

stage0020_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$マヤ$$
「3 minutes until Unit-01 reaches its time limit!」

stage0020_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$ミサト$$
（Hurry, $$シンジ$$.
　$$レイ#333$$ alone can't stop the Angel.）

stage0020_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$マヤ$$
「2 minutes until the time limit!」

stage0020_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Hurry, $$シンジ$$!
　Focus your attacks on the Angel!」

stage0020_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$マヤ$$
「Under a minute to the time limit!」

stage0020_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Unit-00 alone can't stop the Angel!
　We're betting on Unit-01 to the very last second!」

stage0020_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$ミサト$$
「$$シンジ$$, decide it in this one minute!」

stage0020_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$マヤ$$
「Unit-01 has reached its time limit!」

stage0020_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$ミサト$$
「To think it would end here...」

stage0020_04:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$シンジ$$
「If you don't move, this is over!
　Why won't you move!!」

stage0020_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$ブロッケン$$, who got to $$第３新東京市$$ before us,
　apparently got driven off by those guys...」

stage0020_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$赤木$$
「Think about it later!
　Right now, beating that Angel comes first!」

stage0020_04:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$シンジ$$
「If I have no choice but to fight...」

stage0020_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「W-wait, transfer student!
　Just wait a second!」

stage0020_04:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$トウジ$$
「N-no way! Absolutely not!
　You'll die for sure like this!」

stage0020_04:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$シンジ$$
「If you don't want to die, then shut up!」

stage0020_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I don't want to either...!
　I don't want anyone to die, and I don't want to die!」

stage0020_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$甲児$$
「Get ready!
　Now that me and Mazinger are here,
　you're not taking one step further!」

stage0020_04:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$正太郎$$
「This thing has that A.T. Field
　too!?」

stage0020_04:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Charge, $$鉄人$$!
　Break the Field and go for the core!」

stage0020_04:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Every single Angel's got a totally different shape!」

stage0020_04:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「But if it's the enemy, no mercy!
　Me and Trider will beat it down!」

stage0020_04:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Looks like you're after the EVA,
　but I won't let that happen!」

stage0020_04:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$竜馬$$
「If that thing goes Berserk,
　nothing good's gonna come of it!
　I'll settle this before that happens!」

stage0020_04:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$葵$$
「If a different type had to show up,
　I wish it were something more charming...!」

stage0020_04:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$葵$$
「Sorry, but I guess you and I
　just aren't gonna get along after all!」

stage0020_04:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$n
「If we can just break the Field, we have a chance...!」

stage0020_04:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$n!
　Charging in head-on is reckless!」

stage0020_04:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$n
「Reckless or not, I'm doing it!
　If we let it run loose, the world ends!」

stage0020_04:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$赤木$$
「This is the city $$シンジ$$ fought to protect!
　I won't let his effort go to waste!」

stage0020_04:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$赤木$$
「Focus all attacks on one point, same as
　a $$ヘテロダイン$$! I'll show you how it's done!」

stage0020_04:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$タケル$$
「This unease I've felt since back then...!
　What is this creature called an Angel...!」

stage0020_04:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$タケル$$
「The nightmare I saw,
　could these things really be connected to it!」

stage0020_04:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$n
「What are these things...!?
　Are they backing up the Angel...!」

stage0020_04:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$n!
　Focus on beating the enemy right now!」

stage0020_04:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$n
「Don't tell me these things...
　have established a route to invade this world!」
